recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man with a prominent mustache sitting on a sofa draped in a patterned southwestern blanket, with a large grey dog resting its head on his lap. The lighting is warm and directional, creating a cozy, intimate atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a textured, patterned background
Horizontal text overlay bisecting the subject's torso
Warm skin tones and wood accents contrasting with cool denim and grey fur
Direct eye contact from the human subject creating an engaging focal point
coreInvariants: Presence of a resting dog in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The man is the primary subject, centered and occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame; the dog acts as a secondary foreground anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the direct gaze provide the primary anchor, while the dog's head on the lap provides a secondary emotional anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the man's face, moves down to the text, then follows his hands to the dog resting in his lap.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is filled with the subject, the dog, and the textured sofa back.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and reds from the blanket and skin tones provide the base atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the t-shirt and blue of the denim provide structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The white typography acts as a sharp, clean accent against the dark clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and black shirt; moderate saturation in the textile patterns.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage for maximum impact and clarity.
graphicDevices: Thin dark border framing the entire image

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric clarity and modern-classic feel.
Provides a similar wide, geometric uppercase presence.
Captures the geometric monolinear stroke style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A photograph of a man with a mustache sitting on a couch with a southwestern patterned blanket. A grey dog is sleeping on his lap. Warm indoor lighting with shadows on the wall behind him.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered, uppercase, bold geometric sans-serif text in white across the middle of the man's chest. Use wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly centered horizontally?
Is the dog's head clearly visible on the lap?
Does the blanket pattern feel authentic to southwestern textiles?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between human and animal

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the black shirt
The man's gaze is direct and engaging
The dog appears relaxed and integrated into the scene
The color palette remains earthy and warm
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Southwestern Textile + Geometric Sans-Serif Overlay
